Merdeka Group is HIRING!

We are looking to hire a passionate applicant to join our team as Legal Operations Management Support Intern!

Please kindly submit your application by scanning below poster or using this link:
https://lnkd.in/geBxdpWs

WE'RE HIRING: INTERNS! 🚀

Recruitment/Organization Development Intern
Ready to gain hands-on experience in Human Resources?
Farpoint is looking for 2 enthusiastic and proactive interns to join our team!

What You'll Do:
- Recruitment Intern: Support recruitment activities, from candidate sourcing to interview coordination.
- Organization Development Intern: Support employee engagement, learning & development, and organizational development programs.

What We're Looking For:
Active undergraduate students (in final semester), preferably from Psychology, Management, or related majors.
Interested in HR, recruitment, and people development.
Good communication skills, detail-oriented, and eager to learn.

Interested?
Apply now through this link https://bit.ly/FPInterns

[poster text]
Internship
Tlme
MERDEKA
COPPER GOLD
WE ARE HIRING
Legal Operations Management Support Intern
Jakarta, DKI Jakarta
Key Responsibilities:
· Assist in filing, scanning, and organizing legal documents and contracts to maintain a clean
digital and physical archive.
• Assist in coordinating meetings, book room for meeting, managing the legal team's calendar.
• Handle general office tasks such as data entry, preparing meeting minutes, and tracking the
status of legal signatures/notarizations.
· Monitor and maintain the legal document inventory, including tracking the status, completeness,
validity/expiry dates, and proper storage of legal documents managed by the Legal Department.
· Prepare periodic reports on the status of legal documentation and follow up with relevant
parties to ensure timely completion and proper documentation.
Qualifications:
· Final-year student or recent graduate in Law, Business Administration, Secretarial Studies, or a
related field.
. Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint).
· Strong administrative skills and highly attention to detail.
· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in both English and Bahasa Indonesia.
· Willing to do full WFO in SCBD Jakarta Selatan.
